candidateIdentity.variantName: 34mm Black GPQ, Standard-Issue, on black 16 mm Nylon DEFSTAN strap

sourceChecks.note: Marathon's current exact selected-variant page identifies in-stock SKU WW194004BK-0808 on black Nylon DEFSTAN at USD 470 with positive inventory. It also establishes General Purpose Field Series identity, 34 x 11.5 x 41 mm geometry, 16 mm lugs, fibreshell, high-torque quartz, sapphire, pressure crown, 3 ATM, no calendar, tritium, and full nighttime visibility. Shopify's separate 133 g property is a shipment field and is not watch mass. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Marathon's current exact WW194004BK-0808 sheet independently identifies the black 16 mm Nylon DEFSTAN strap and ETA F06.105 HeavyDrive, plus three jewels, EOL, tritium placement, sapphire, pressure crown, 34 x 11.5 x 41 mm geometry, 16 mm lugs, fibreshell, and 3 ATM. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

ETA's F06.105 technical specification, revision dated 2026-02-10, gives instantaneous rate at 25 degrees Celsius as minimum -0.30, typical +0.10, and maximum +0.50 seconds per day. Marathon's exact sheet identifies F06.105, making these exact-applicable bounds. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

This exact WW194004 GPQ hands-on article reports approximately 44 g including its installed MIL-S-46383B Type II nylon strap, explicitly describes fixed bars with a one-piece strap, and documents continuous self-illumination. Primary Marathon material separately fixes the selected black DEFSTAN configuration and full-night behavior. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

This current authorized-dealer exact-WW194004 page independently corroborates -0.3/+0.5 seconds per day, the 16 mm nylon configuration, and constant low-light tritium visibility. ETA and Marathon primary documents remain controlling. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
Marathon's official database links current WW194004 documentation and identifies the family in its service system. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Marathon's maintenance material includes replacement of damaged or unusable bars. Combined with exact-GPQ fixed-bar inspection and the one-piece strap, this supports a fixed but manufacturer-serviceable interface. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
The dealer names F06.115, conflicting with Marathon's exact WW194004 sheet and describing a date-capable suffix for this no-date watch. No movement fact is retained. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
Amazon's 3.53-ounce value is package weight, not full installed watch mass. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
F06.412 is a different suffix and cannot establish facts for Marathon's F06.105 installation.
